## Due date

**Due:** Friday, October 23, 2026, at 11:59 PM Chicago Time

The deadline in WileyPLUS is authoritative; Canvas's Due and Until fields
are intentionally blank.

## Assignment

Complete these five WileyPLUS questions. Each is worth **4 points**, for
**20 points** total.

1. Chapter 4, Section 4.1, Question 11 — vector-space axioms with specified operations
2. Chapter 4, Section 4.3, Question 09 — spanning a polynomial space
3. Chapter 4, Section 4.4, Question 11 — parameter-dependent linear independence
4. Chapter 4, Section 4.5, Question 16 — coordinates of a matrix relative to a basis
5. Chapter 4, Section 4.8, Question 09a — bases for the null space and row space

These are the question identifiers shown in WileyPLUS. Review the relevant
sections of the [Vector Spaces and Span slides](../slides/06-general-vector-spaces.html),
[Bases and Coordinates slides](../slides/07-bases-dimension-and-coordinates.html),
and [Matrix Spaces and Rank slides](../slides/08-matrix-spaces-and-rank.html).

## Submission and grading

Launch [Assignment 4 in Canvas]({{< meta canvas.assignment_4 >}}) and complete
it **individually** in WileyPLUS. Follow the
[course assignment ground rules](../pages/assignments.qmd#individual-assignments).

- The assignment is automatically graded, with **three attempts per question**,
  **no score reduction**, and the **best score** retained.
- WileyPLUS randomizes values for each student while keeping that student's
  values fixed across attempts.
- Answer feedback is available as answers are submitted. Textbook resources
  are always available; hints become available after the first attempt, and
  correct answers and solutions after the last attempt. Assistance carries
  no score deduction.
- Work is automatically submitted to the Canvas gradebook on the due date.
  WileyPLUS notes that auto-submission uses one attempt and may take up to
  ten minutes. Submit your answers before the deadline.
- Late submissions are not enabled. Assignment review becomes available
  after the deadline.
